title: The enthalpy of dilution of some 1-1 and 2-1 electrolytes in aqueous solution
authors: Wing H. Leung, Frank J. Millero
experimental_method: Microcalorimeter measurement of enthalpies of dilution of aqueous salt solutions from about 1 mol/kg to final molalities 0.1-1.0 mol/kg at 303.15 K; solutions prepared by mass with ion-exchanged water.
uncertainties_stated: Fit standard deviation of +/-2 cal_th/mol for all salts; NaCl test at 298.15 K agreed with Parker's tabulation within +/-1 cal_th/mol; duplicate runs reproduce.
quality_remarks: Molalities of CaCl2, SrCl2, BaCl2 solutions were determined by mass titration with AgNO3. Temperature scale and pressure not stated. SrCl2 row 0.74438: expt 77.87 vs calc 79.08, difference larger than for neighbours (as printed).
